d: We are seeking a strategic, analytical, and results-oriented Organisational Planning Manager to lead organizational planning, performance management, and strategic execution initiatives.

The role will be responsible for translating corporate objectives into actionable business plans, aligning departmental goals with organizational priorities, monitoring performance against strategic targets, and ensuring effective utilization of organizational resources.

The ideal candidate will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to strengthen organizational effectiveness, improve planning processes, and drive sustainable business performance.
Lead the development and coordination of annual organizational plans in alignment with corporate strategy and business objectives.
Translate strategic priorities into departmental goals, measurable targets, KPIs, and actionable execution plans.
Coordinate the annual business planning, budgeting, and resource allocation processes across departments.
Monitor organizational performance against approved plans, strategic targets, and key performance indicators.
Develop and maintain organizational performance dashboards, planning reports, and management review presentations.
Conduct periodic performance reviews to identify gaps, assess progress, and recommend corrective actions.
Work closely with department heads to ensure alignment between functional plans and overall organizational objectives.
Assess organizational capacity, resource requirements, and workforce planning needs to support business priorities.
Identify opportunities to improve organizational efficiency, productivity, and resource utilization.
Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions and strategic review meetings with business stakeholders.
Support organizational restructuring, business transformation, and strategic change initiatives.
Conduct scenario planning, business analysis, and risk assessments to support management decision-making.
Establish standardized planning frameworks, reporting processes, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
Prepare periodic strategic and operational performance updates for senior management.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, or a related discipline.
MBA or professional qualification in Strategic Management, Business Planning, or Project Management will be an advantage.
5–8 years of relevant experience in organizational planning, strategic planning, business planning, or performance management.
Strong understanding of corporate strategy, annual operating plans, budgeting, and KPI frameworks.
Experience in organizational performance monitoring, resource planning, and cross-functional coordination.
Advanced MS Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Working knowledge of Power BI, ERP systems, and business performance management tools.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.

Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own go-to-market for Lucidya's AI Unit. The AI Unit ships fast and plans in short cycles to keep pace with a rapidly changing market. This role ensures that every release is clearly positioned, well understood by our internal teams, and adopted by our customers.

You will report into the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing while working day to day with the AI Unit. You will be the bridge between the team building our AI capabilities and the people who sell, support, and use them.
q: 3+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS
Experience marketing AI, machine learning, or data products
A track record of running successful product launches in a fast-moving environment
Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them simply
Comfort working across teams and managing multiple releases at once
Ability to adapt quickly as plans and priorities change
Experience in customer experience, or marketing technology
Arabic and English fluency is a must
r: Partner with the AI Unit to stay ahead of its monthly release plans and turn them into a clear launch calendar
Define launch tiers and plan the right level of go-to-market activity for each release
Lead launches end to end, from messaging and enablement to customer announcements and post-launch reporting
Develop positioning and messaging for AI capabilities that is clear, credible, and focused on customer value
Translate technical features into outcomes that resonate with Support, CX, marketing, and business leaders
Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials, product content, and campaigns
Build and maintain enablement materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, demo narratives, FAQs, and battle cards
Run enablement sessions so Sales and Customer Success can confidently explain and sell new AI capabilities
Work with Customer Marketing to drive adoption of AI features among existing customers
Track the AI and Agentic CX landscape, including competitor moves and emerging trends
Gather customer and prospect feedback and share insights with the AI Unit and Product teams
Help shape priorities by bringing the voice of the market into planning discussions
Define and track success metrics for launches, including awareness, pipeline influence, and feature adoption
Report results to the Director of Product Marketing and Customer Marketing and AI Unit leadership
